final: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM invoice_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.invoice_count, 1.0 * c.invoice_count / o.total_count AS share FROM invoice_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.value
